init_ref_tools.name: nasa_get_apod
init_ref_tools.description: Get the NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day with explanation. Optionally specify a date. Example: get_apod({ date: "2024-01-15", _apiKey: "DEMO_KEY" })

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, defaults to today). Range: 1995-06-16 to today.

_apiKey.description: NASA API key (optional, defaults to DEMO_KEY — get a free key at api.nasa.gov)

init_ref_tools.name: get_asteroids
init_ref_tools.description: Get near-Earth asteroids approaching within a date range (max 7 days). Returns size, velocity, and miss distance. Example: get_asteroids({ start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-07", _apiKey: "DEMO_KEY" })

_apiKey.description: NASA API key (optional, defaults to DEMO_KEY)

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (max 7 days after start)

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

init_ref_tools.name: get_mars_photos
init_ref_tools.description: Get photos taken by Mars rovers (Curiosity, Opportunity, Spirit). Filter by Martian sol and camera. Example: get_mars_photos({ sol: 1000, camera: "FHAZ", _apiKey: "DEMO_KEY" })

sol.description: Martian sol (day) to retrieve photos from, e.g. 1000 (default: 1000)

_apiKey.description: NASA API key (optional, defaults to DEMO_KEY)

init_ref_tools.name: usgs_earthquake_get_recent
init_ref_tools.description: Get recent earthquakes worldwide, optionally filtered by minimum magnitude. Returns location, magnitude, depth, and time. Example: get_recent({ minmagnitude: 4.5, limit: 10 })

minmagnitude.description: Minimum magnitude to include, e.g. 2.5 for notable, 4.5 for significant (default: 2.5)

init_ref_tools.name: search_earthquakes
init_ref_tools.description: Search for earthquakes by date range, magnitude, and geographic location. Supports circular area search by lat/lon/radius. Example: search_earthquakes({ starttime: "2024-01-01", endtime: "2024-01-31", minmagnitude: 5.0 }) or search_earthquakes({ starttime: "2024-01-01", endtime: "2024-12-31", latitude: 35.68, longitude: 139.69, maxradius: 5, minmagnitude: 3.0 })

latitude.description: Center latitude for geographic search, -90 to 90 (optional)

longitude.description: Center longitude for geographic search, -180 to 180 (optional)

maxradius.description: Maximum search radius in degrees from lat/lon (max 180, optional)

init_ref_tools.name: usgs_earthquake_get_event
init_ref_tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific earthquake event by its USGS event ID. Example: get_event({ eventid: "us7000m0xl" })

eventid.description: USGS event ID, e.g. "us7000m0xl" (found in search results)

init_ref_tools.name: get_datasets
init_ref_tools.description: List all available IMF databases/datasets. Returns database IDs and names you can use with get_data and search_indicators. Example: call with no arguments to browse available datasets like IFS (International Financial Statistics), BOP (Balance of Payments), etc.

init_ref_tools.name: imf_get_data
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch IMF time-series data for an indicator and country. Uses SDMX CompactData format. Example: get_data({ database_id: "IFS", frequency: "A", indicator: "NGDP_XDC", country: "US", start: "2018", end: "2023" }) returns annual nominal GDP for the US.

country.description: ISO 2-letter country code, e.g. "US", "GB", "JP". Omit for all countries.

indicator.description: Indicator code, e.g. "NGDP_XDC" for nominal GDP. Use search_indicators to find codes.

init_ref_tools.name: search_indicators
init_ref_tools.description: Search or list indicator codes available in an IMF database. Returns the code list (dimensions) for a dataset. Example: search_indicators({ database_id: "IFS", query: "GDP" }) finds GDP-related indicator codes.

query.description: Optional search term to filter indicators, e.g. "GDP", "inflation", "trade"

database_id.description: IMF database ID to search within, e.g. "IFS"

init_ref_tools.name: posthog_get_events
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch recent events from a PostHog project. Returns event names, timestamps, and properties. Example: get_events({ project_id: "12345", limit: 50, _apiKey: "phx_..." })

project_id.description: PostHog project ID (numeric string)

init_ref_tools.name: get_persons
init_ref_tools.description: Search for persons (users) in a PostHog project. Returns user profiles with properties. Example: get_persons({ project_id: "12345", search: "john@example.com", _apiKey: "phx_..." })

search.description: Optional search query to filter persons by email, name, or distinct ID

project_id.description: PostHog project ID (numeric string)

init_ref_tools.name: get_insights
init_ref_tools.description: List saved insights (charts, trends, funnels) for a PostHog project. Returns insight names, types, and configurations. Example: get_insights({ project_id: "12345", _apiKey: "phx_..." })

project_id.description: PostHog project ID (numeric string)

init_ref_tools.name: sendgrid_get_stats
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch email sending statistics (delivered, opens, clicks, bounces, etc.) for a date range. Example: get_stats({ start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "SG.xxx" })

end_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

init_ref_tools.name: get_blocks
init_ref_tools.description: List email addresses that have been blocked by SendGrid. These are emails that were rejected due to receiving server issues. Example: get_blocks({ limit: 50, _apiKey: "SG.xxx" })

init_ref_tools.name: get_bounces
init_ref_tools.description: List email addresses that have bounced. Includes bounce reason and timestamp. Example: get_bounces({ limit: 100, _apiKey: "SG.xxx" })

init_ref_tools.name: mixpanel_get_events
init_ref_tools.description: Query event data from Mixpanel for a date range. Returns event counts and properties. Example: get_events({ from_date: "2024-01-01", to_date: "2024-01-31", event: "Sign Up", _apiKey: "your_api_secret" })

event.description: Optional specific event name to filter by, e.g. "Sign Up", "Purchase"

_apiKey.description: Mixpanel API secret (used for Basic auth)

to_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

from_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

init_ref_tools.name: get_funnels
init_ref_tools.description: Get funnel conversion data from Mixpanel. Shows step-by-step conversion rates. Example: get_funnels({ funnel_id: "12345", from_date: "2024-01-01", to_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "your_api_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Mixpanel API secret (used for Basic auth)

init_ref_tools.name: get_retention
init_ref_tools.description: Get user retention cohort data from Mixpanel. Shows how many users return over time. Example: get_retention({ from_date: "2024-01-01", to_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "your_api_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Mixpanel API secret (used for Basic auth)

init_ref_tools.name: get_accounts
init_ref_tools.description: List all linked bank accounts for an access token. Returns account names, types, balances, and masks. Example: get_accounts({ access_token: "access-sandbox-xxx", _apiKey: "client_id:secret" })

access_token.description: Plaid access token for the linked institution (access-sandbox-xxx)

init_ref_tools.name: get_transactions
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch bank transactions for a date range. Returns transaction names, amounts, categories, and dates. Example: get_transactions({ access_token: "access-sandbox-xxx", start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "client_id:secret" })

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

access_token.description: Plaid access token for the linked institution

init_ref_tools.name: plaid_get_balance
init_ref_tools.description: Get real-time account balances for linked accounts. Returns current, available, and limit balances. Example: get_balance({ access_token: "access-sandbox-xxx", _apiKey: "client_id:secret" })

access_token.description: Plaid access token for the linked institution

init_ref_tools.name: gnews_search_news
init_ref_tools.description: Search global news articles by keyword (e.g., "climate change", "AI regulation"). Returns title, description, content snippet, source, and publication date. Supports language and country filters.

query.description: Search keywords (e.g., "electric vehicles")

country.description: Country code (e.g., "us", "gb", "ca"). Omit for global

init_ref_tools.name: gnews_top_headlines
init_ref_tools.description: Get top news headlines, optionally filtered by category (general, world, nation, business, technology, entertainment, sports, science, health). Returns title, description, source, and publication date.

country.description: Country code (e.g., "us", "gb"). Omit for global

category.description: News category: general, world, nation, business, technology, entertainment, sports, science, health

init_ref_tools.name: search_documents
init_ref_tools.description: Search the US Federal Register by topic / keyword for proposed rules, final rules, notices, and presidential documents. **Use this whenever the question mentions a SUBJECT** ("EV tax credits", "AI export controls", "PFAS regulations", "clean energy", "ozempic labeling", etc.) — recent_rules takes no topic filter and would return random unrelated rules. Returns title, abstract, agency, publication date, links. Examples: search_documents({query: "EV tax credit", type: "rule"}), search_documents({query: "artificial intelligence", agency: "commerce-department"}).

type.description: Document type filter: "rule", "proposed_rule", "notice", "presidential_document"

query.description: Search keywords (e.g., "clean energy tax credit")

init_ref_tools.name: get_document
init_ref_tools.description: Get full details for a Federal Register document by its document number (e.g., "2024-12345"). Returns title, abstract, full text link, agencies, dates, and docket information.

init_ref_tools.name: recent_rules
init_ref_tools.description: Browse the most recently published final rules and regulations from the Federal Register, **with no topic filter** — returns whatever was published most recently across every agency (FAA airworthiness directives, Coast Guard safety zones, EPA tolerance exemptions, etc.). For questions about a specific topic ("EV tax credits", "AI rules", "drug pricing"), use search_documents instead. Returns title, abstract, agency, effective dates, significance.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

init_ref_tools.name: search_opinions
init_ref_tools.description: Search US court opinions by keyword (e.g., "qualified immunity", "Fourth Amendment"). Returns case name, court, date, docket number, and text snippet. Covers federal and state courts.

court.description: Court filter (e.g., "scotus" for Supreme Court, "ca9" for 9th Circuit)

query.description: Search keywords (e.g., "patent infringement software")

init_ref_tools.name: court_listener_search_dockets
init_ref_tools.description: Search US court dockets by keyword. Returns case name, court, filing date, docket number, nature of suit, and assigned judge. Covers PACER and RECAP archives.

court.description: Court filter (e.g., "nysd" for Southern District of New York)

query.description: Search keywords (e.g., "antitrust merger")

init_ref_tools.name: get_opinion
init_ref_tools.description: Get a specific court opinion by its CourtListener ID. Returns the full opinion text, author, date, and download link.

init_ref_tools.name: open_sanctions_search_entities
init_ref_tools.description: Search global sanctions, watchlists, and PEP (politically exposed persons) databases. Returns matched entities with names, countries, datasets, and sanctions details. Example: search_entities("Vladimir Putin") or search_entities("Huawei", schema="Company")

query.description: Name or keyword to search (e.g., "Gazprom", "Kim Jong")

init_ref_tools.name: open_sanctions_get_entity
init_ref_tools.description: Get full details for a sanctioned entity by its OpenSanctions ID. Returns all properties including names, addresses, identifiers, sanctions programs, and related entities.

init_ref_tools.name: get_indicators
init_ref_tools.description: Search or list WHO Global Health Observatory indicators. Returns indicator codes and names. Use the indicator code with get_data to retrieve actual values. Example: get_indicators("life expectancy") or get_indicators("malaria")

query.description: Optional search keyword to filter indicators (e.g., "mortality", "tuberculosis"). Omit to list all.

init_ref_tools.name: who_gho_get_data
init_ref_tools.description: Get health data values for a WHO indicator code. Returns numeric values by country and year. Example: get_data("WHOSIS_000001", country="USA", year="2020"). Use get_indicators first to find the indicator code.

country.description: ISO 3-letter country code (e.g., "USA", "GBR", "JPN")

indicator.description: WHO indicator code (e.g., "WHOSIS_000001" for life expectancy)

init_ref_tools.name: who_gho_list_countries
init_ref_tools.description: List all countries recognized by the WHO with their ISO codes. Useful for finding the correct country code to use with get_data.

init_ref_tools.name: open_corporates_search_companies
init_ref_tools.description: Search global company registries by name. Returns company name, jurisdiction, status, type, incorporation date, and registered address. Covers 140+ jurisdictions worldwide. Example: search_companies("Tesla", country="us")

query.description: Company name to search (e.g., "Acme Corp")

country.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., "us", "gb", "de")

init_ref_tools.name: open_corporates_get_company
init_ref_tools.description: Get full details for a specific company by jurisdiction and company number. Returns registration details, officers, filings, and industry codes. Example: get_company("us_de", "4483789") for a Delaware company.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (e.g., "us_de" for Delaware, "gb" for UK, "ca_on" for Ontario)

init_ref_tools.name: search_officers
init_ref_tools.description: Search company officers and directors by name. Returns officer name, position, company, start/end dates, and nationality. Example: search_officers("Elon Musk")

query.description: Officer name to search (e.g., "John Smith")

init_ref_tools.name: search_candidates
init_ref_tools.description: Search federal election candidates by name, state, or party. Returns candidate ID, name, party, office, state, district, and election years. Example: search_candidates("Biden", state="DE", party="DEM")

query.description: Candidate name to search (e.g., "Sanders")

init_ref_tools.name: candidate_financials
init_ref_tools.description: Get campaign finance summary for a candidate by their FEC candidate ID (e.g., "P80001571"). Returns total receipts, disbursements, cash on hand, individual contributions, PAC contributions, and loans. Use search_candidates first to find the candidate ID.

cycle.description: Election cycle year (e.g., 2024). Defaults to most recent.

init_ref_tools.name: search_committees
init_ref_tools.description: Search political committees (PACs, Super PACs, party committees) by name. Returns committee ID, name, type, designation, party, treasurer, and associated candidates. Example: search_committees("ActBlue")

query.description: Committee name to search (e.g., "Americans for Prosperity")

init_ref_tools.name: semantic_scholar_search_papers
init_ref_tools.description: Search academic papers across all fields of science. Returns title, abstract, TL;DR summary, authors, citation count, year, journal, and open access PDF links. Example: search_papers("transformer attention mechanism", year="2023")

query.description: Search keywords (e.g., "CRISPR gene editing", "large language models")

init_ref_tools.name: semantic_scholar_get_paper
init_ref_tools.description: Get full details for an academic paper by its Semantic Scholar paper ID, DOI, ArXiv ID, or other identifier. Returns title, abstract, TL;DR, authors, citations, references, open access link, and journal info. Example: get_paper("DOI:10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2")

paper_id.description: Paper identifier: Semantic Scholar ID, "DOI:10.xxx", "ArXiv:xxxx.xxxxx", "PMID:xxxxxxxx", or "CorpusId:xxxxxxxx"

init_ref_tools.name: semantic_scholar_get_author
init_ref_tools.description: Get an academic author profile by Semantic Scholar author ID. Returns name, affiliations, h-index, total citations, paper count, and recent publications. Use search_papers first to find author IDs.

init_ref_tools.name: search_nonprofits
init_ref_tools.description: Search US nonprofits by name. Returns EIN, name, city, state, revenue, assets, and NTEE code. Example: search_nonprofits("red cross", "NY"). Use get_organization with the EIN for full details.

query.description: Name or keyword to search for (e.g., "habitat for humanity")

state.description: Two-letter state code to filter results (e.g., "CA", "NY")

init_ref_tools.name: get_organization
init_ref_tools.description: Get full nonprofit details by EIN (Employer Identification Number). Returns organization info plus recent IRS filings with revenue, expenses, and assets. Example: get_organization(131710957).

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (e.g., 131710957 for American Red Cross)

init_ref_tools.name: get_filing
init_ref_tools.description: Get a specific IRS filing for a nonprofit. Returns financial data from one tax period including revenue, expenses, assets, and liabilities. Example: get_filing(131710957, 202112).

tax_period.description: Tax period in YYYYMM format (e.g., 202112 for December 2021)

init_ref_tools.name: get_flights
init_ref_tools.description: Get all flights within a time interval (max 2 hours). Returns ICAO24 address, callsign, departure/arrival airports. Provide begin and end as Unix timestamps. Example: get_flights(1696118400, 1696125600).

end.description: End of time interval as Unix timestamp (seconds, max 2h after begin)

begin.description: Start of time interval as Unix timestamp (seconds)

init_ref_tools.name: opensky_get_aircraft
init_ref_tools.description: Get flights for a specific aircraft by its ICAO24 transponder address (hex string, e.g., "3c675a"). Returns departure/arrival airports and times. Optionally specify a time range.

end.description: End of time interval as Unix timestamp (optional, defaults to now)

begin.description: Start of time interval as Unix timestamp (optional, defaults to last 24h)

init_ref_tools.name: opensky_get_states
init_ref_tools.description: Get current state vectors (live positions) of aircraft. Returns position, altitude, velocity, and heading for all aircraft currently tracked. Optionally filter by ICAO24 addresses.

icao24.description: Filter by one or more ICAO24 addresses (comma-separated, e.g., "3c675a,3c675b")

init_ref_tools.name: airspace_activity
init_ref_tools.description: Summary of live flight activity over a named region — total aircraft count, by-country breakdown of operators, average altitude, ground vs in-air split. Built for "is airspace open / closed" style geopolitical bets (Polymarket "Iran closes its airspace by X", "Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal", "Russia closes airspace"). Supported regions: Iran, Israel, Syria, Ukraine, Russia, Taiwan, North Korea, South China Sea, Yemen, Strait of Hormuz, Taiwan Strait, Red Sea, Saudi Arabia, Gulf of Aden, Lebanon.

region.description: Region name (case-insensitive). Use one of the named regions above, or use get_states with an icao24 filter for custom areas.

init_ref_tools.name: search_schools
init_ref_tools.description: Search US colleges and universities by name. Returns school name, location, tuition, admission rate, student size, median earnings, and completion rate. Example: search_schools("MIT", "MA").

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)

query.description: School name to search for (e.g., "Stanford", "community college")

init_ref_tools.name: get_school
init_ref_tools.description: Get detailed info for a specific college by its College Scorecard ID. Returns tuition, admission rate, student size, median earnings after 10 years, completion rate, and median debt.

id.description: College Scorecard school ID (numeric, from search results)

init_ref_tools.name: open_food_facts_search_products
init_ref_tools.description: Search food products by name or keyword. Returns product name, brand, nutrition facts (per 100g), Nutri-Score, NOVA group, allergens, and ingredients. Example: search_products("nutella", "spreads").

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

query.description: Product name or keyword (e.g., "oat milk", "chocolate")

categories.description: Category tag to filter by (e.g., "beverages", "cereals")

init_ref_tools.name: open_food_facts_get_product
init_ref_tools.description: Get detailed food product info by barcode (EAN/UPC). Returns full nutrition facts, ingredients, Nutri-Score, allergens, and labels. Example: get_product("3017620422003") for Nutella.

init_ref_tools.name: get_categories
init_ref_tools.description: List popular food product categories from Open Food Facts. Returns category names and product counts. Useful for discovering what categories are available for filtering searches.

init_ref_tools.name: nager_date_get_holidays
init_ref_tools.description: Get all public holidays for a country and year. Returns holiday names, dates, and types (public, bank, school, etc.). Example: get_holidays(2025, "US").

init_ref_tools.name: nager_date_is_today_holiday
init_ref_tools.description: Check if today is a public holiday in a given country. Returns true/false. Example: is_today_holiday("US").

init_ref_tools.name: get_long_weekends
init_ref_tools.description: Get long weekends (3+ consecutive days off) for a country and year. Shows which weekends can become long breaks, including whether a "bridge day" (vacation day) is needed. Great for trip planning. Example: get_long_weekends(2025, "DE").

init_ref_tools.name: nager_date_list_countries
init_ref_tools.description: List all countries supported by the holiday API with their ISO country codes. Use these codes with get_holidays and other tools.

init_ref_tools.name: geonames_search_places
init_ref_tools.description: Search for places (cities, landmarks, regions) by name. Returns coordinates, country, population, and feature type. Example: search_places("Paris", "FR"). Use get_nearby to find places near a known location.

query.description: Place name to search for (e.g., "Tokyo", "Grand Canyon")

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter (e.g., "US", "JP")

init_ref_tools.name: get_nearby
init_ref_tools.description: Find places near a given latitude/longitude. Returns nearby cities, landmarks, and features sorted by distance. Example: get_nearby(48.8566, 2.3522) for places near Paris.

lng.description: Longitude (e.g., 2.3522)

init_ref_tools.name: geonames_get_timezone
init_ref_tools.description: Get timezone information for a latitude/longitude location. Returns timezone ID, GMT offset, DST offset, current local time, sunrise, and sunset. Example: get_timezone(40.7128, -74.0060) for New York.

lng.description: Longitude (e.g., -74.0060)

init_ref_tools.name: propublica_congress_get_members
init_ref_tools.description: List members of a chamber of Congress. Returns name, party, state, district, vote attendance, and party loyalty percentage. Example: get_members("senate", 118).

init_ref_tools.name: propublica_congress_get_member
init_ref_tools.description: Get details for a specific member of Congress by their ProPublica member ID. Returns biography, current role, committee assignments, and voting record. Example: get_member("S001191").

member_id.description: ProPublica member ID (e.g., "S001191" for Chuck Schumer)

init_ref_tools.name: propublica_congress_search_bills
init_ref_tools.description: Search congressional bills by keyword. Returns bill ID, title, sponsor, status, and latest action. Example: search_bills("climate change", 118).

query.description: Keywords to search for in bill text/titles

init_ref_tools.name: propublica_congress_get_votes
init_ref_tools.description: Get recent votes in a chamber for a specific year and month. Returns vote question, result, vote counts (yes/no), and related bill info. Example: get_votes("senate", 2024, 3).

init_ref_tools.name: estimate_electricity
init_ref_tools.description: Estimate CO2 emissions from electricity usage. Returns carbon emissions in grams, kg, and metric tons. Example: estimate_electricity(500, "us", "kwh") for 500 kWh in the US.

state.description: US state code for more precise estimate (e.g., "ca", "ny"). Only for US.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., "us", "gb", "de")

init_ref_tools.name: estimate_flight
init_ref_tools.description: Estimate CO2 emissions from a flight. Provide number of passengers and flight legs (departure/arrival airport IATA codes). Returns per-passenger and total carbon emissions. Example: estimate_flight(2, [{"departure_airport": "SFO", "destination_airport": "JFK"}]).

legs.description: Array of flight legs with IATA airport codes

init_ref_tools.name: estimate_vehicle
init_ref_tools.description: Estimate CO2 emissions from driving a vehicle. Provide distance and a vehicle model ID (from Carbon Interface). Returns carbon emissions in grams, kg, and metric tons. Example: estimate_vehicle(100, "7268a9b7-17e8-4c8d-acca-57059252afe9", "mi").

init_ref_tools.name: abuseipdb_check_ip
init_ref_tools.description: Check an IP address against the AbuseIPDB database. Returns abuse confidence score (0-100), ISP, usage type, country, number of reports, and last reported date. Example: check_ip("8.8.8.8").

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to check (e.g., "118.25.6.39")

init_ref_tools.name: report_ip
init_ref_tools.description: Report an abusive IP address to AbuseIPDB. Requires category IDs (e.g., "18,22" for DDoS + SSH brute force). Returns the updated abuse confidence score.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to report (e.g., "118.25.6.39")

comment.description: Description of the abuse (e.g., "SSH brute force attack from this IP")

categories.description: Comma-separated category IDs (e.g., "18,22"). Common: 3=Fraud, 4=DDoS, 14=Port Scan, 18=Brute Force, 22=SSH, 23=Telnet

init_ref_tools.name: get_blacklist
init_ref_tools.description: Get the AbuseIPDB blacklist of the most-reported IP addresses. Returns IPs with their abuse confidence scores. Useful for building blocklists.

limit.description: Number of IPs to return (default 100, max 10000)

init_ref_tools.name: shodan_internetdb_lookup_ip
init_ref_tools.description: Look up an IP address in the Shodan InternetDB. Returns open ports, hostnames, known vulnerabilities (CVEs), CPEs (software identifiers), and tags. Free, no API key needed. Example: lookup_ip("8.8.8.8").

init_ref_tools.name: check_url
init_ref_tools.description: Check if a URL is a known phishing site in the PhishTank database. Returns whether it is a phish, verification status, and details URL. Example: check_url("http://suspicious-site.example.com/login").

url.description: The full URL to check for phishing (e.g., "http://example.com/fake-login")

init_ref_tools.name: datagov_search_datasets
init_ref_tools.description: Search U.S. government open datasets on Data.gov by keyword. Returns titles, descriptions, organizations, formats, and download URLs. Example: search_datasets("climate change", organization: "noaa-gov").

query.description: Search keywords (e.g., "climate change", "census population")

init_ref_tools.name: datagov_get_dataset
init_ref_tools.description: Get full metadata for a specific Data.gov dataset by its ID or name. Returns title, description, resources (download links), organization, tags, and update frequency.

id.description: Dataset ID or name slug from Data.gov

init_ref_tools.name: list_organizations
init_ref_tools.description: List all organizations publishing datasets on Data.gov. Returns organization names and dataset counts. Useful for discovering data publishers.

init_ref_tools.name: search_url
init_ref_tools.description: Search the Wayback Machine CDX index for archived snapshots of a URL. Returns timestamps, HTTP status codes, MIME types, and archive URLs. Filter by date range. Example: search_url("example.com", from: "2020", to: "2023", limit: 10).

to.description: End date filter as YYYYMMDD or partial (e.g., "2023", "20231231")

url.description: URL to search for in the archive (e.g., "example.com" or "https://example.com/page")

from.description: Start date filter as YYYYMMDD or partial (e.g., "2020", "202301")

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default 25, max 1000)

init_ref_tools.name: check_availability
init_ref_tools.description: Check if a URL has been archived by the Wayback Machine and get the closest available snapshot. Returns the archive URL and timestamp if available.

url.description: URL to check for availability (e.g., "https://example.com")

init_ref_tools.name: frankfurter_get_latest
init_ref_tools.description: Get the latest foreign exchange rates from the ECB. Returns rates relative to a base currency. Example: get_latest(base: "USD", symbols: "EUR,GBP,JPY").

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currency codes (e.g., "USD,GBP,JPY"). Omit for all currencies.

init_ref_tools.name: frankfurter_get_historical
init_ref_tools.description: Get exchange rates for a specific historical date. ECB rates available from 1999-01-04 onward. Example: get_historical(date: "2024-01-15", base: "USD").

init_ref_tools.name: get_timeseries
init_ref_tools.description: Get exchange rates over a date range for trend analysis. Returns daily rates between start and end dates. Example: get_timeseries(start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-03-31", base: "USD", symbols: "EUR").

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

init_ref_tools.name: list_currencies
init_ref_tools.description: List all currencies supported by the Frankfurter API (ECB reference rates). Returns currency codes and full names.

init_ref_tools.name: sec_xbrl_get_company_facts
init_ref_tools.description: Get all XBRL financial facts for a company by CIK number. Returns all reported financial data (revenue, net income, assets, etc.) across all filings. Example: get_company_facts(cik: "320193") for Apple Inc.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (e.g., "320193" for Apple, "789019" for Microsoft)

init_ref_tools.name: get_company_concept
init_ref_tools.description: Get a specific financial metric for a company across all filings. Use this to track revenue, net income, or any XBRL tag over time. Example: get_company_concept(cik: "320193", taxonomy: "us-gaap", tag: "Revenue").

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (e.g., "320193" for Apple)

init_ref_tools.name: search_filings
init_ref_tools.description: Search recent SEC filings for a company by CIK. Optionally filter by filing type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.). Returns filing dates, types, and accession numbers.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (e.g., "320193" for Apple)

type.description: Filing type filter (e.g., "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "DEF 14A")

init_ref_tools.name: get_company_financials
init_ref_tools.description: High-level summary of a public US company's annual (10-K) financials: revenue, net income, total assets, cash, EPS, etc. Returns clean numerical values with the XBRL tag used and the period-end date. By default returns the most recent fiscal year; pass `fiscal_year_end` to get a specific year (e.g. "2024-12-31" for Tesla FY2024 or just "2024" to auto-match the year). Prefer this over get_company_facts/get_company_concept for any single-company financial snapshot question. Pass a CIK (e.g. "320193") or a ticker (e.g. "AAPL"; auto-resolves to CIK).

company.description: CIK (e.g., "320193", "0000320193") OR ticker symbol (e.g., "AAPL", "TSLA", "MSFT"). Ticker is auto-resolved to CIK via SEC EDGAR.

fiscal_year_end.description: Optional. Pass a 4-digit fiscal year ("2024") to get values from any 10-K period ending in that calendar year, OR a specific period-end date ("2024-12-31"). Omit to get the most recent fiscal year.

init_ref_tools.name: cdc_search_datasets
init_ref_tools.description: Search CDC public health datasets by keyword. Returns dataset names, descriptions, IDs, and update dates. Example: search_datasets("influenza surveillance").

query.description: Search keywords (e.g., "covid cases", "influenza", "vaccination rates", "mortality")

init_ref_tools.name: cdc_get_dataset
init_ref_tools.description: Get rows from a specific CDC dataset by its Socrata dataset ID (four-by-four format like "xxxx-xxxx"). Returns data rows with all columns. Use search_datasets first to find the ID.

id.description: Socrata dataset ID in four-by-four format (e.g., "9mfq-cb36")

limit.description: Number of rows to return (default 50, max 1000)

init_ref_tools.name: core_research_search_papers
init_ref_tools.description: Search open-access research papers by keyword (e.g., "machine learning healthcare"). Returns titles, authors, abstracts, DOIs, and download links. Useful for literature reviews and finding academic sources.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "climate change mitigation", "CRISPR gene editing")

init_ref_tools.name: core_research_get_paper
init_ref_tools.description: Get full metadata for a research paper by its CORE ID. Returns title, authors, abstract, full text link, DOI, publisher, year, and citation count.

init_ref_tools.name: country_state_city_list_countries
init_ref_tools.description: List all countries with ISO codes, capitals, phone codes, currencies, and regions. Returns ~250 countries. Useful for building dropdowns or validating country data.

init_ref_tools.name: country_state_city_get_states
init_ref_tools.description: Get all states or provinces for a country by ISO2 code (e.g., "US", "IN", "BR"). Returns state names, codes, and types.

init_ref_tools.name: get_cities
init_ref_tools.description: Get cities for a country, optionally filtered by state. Pass country_code (e.g., "US") and optionally state_code (e.g., "CA") to narrow results.

init_ref_tools.name: metals_api_get_latest
init_ref_tools.description: Get the latest precious and base metal spot prices (gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, etc.). Prices are per troy ounce. Optionally specify base currency and metal symbols.

symbols.description: Comma-separated metal symbols to filter (e.g., "XAU,XAG,XPT"). XAU=gold, XAG=silver, XPT=platinum, XPD=palladium, XCU=copper

init_ref_tools.name: metals_api_get_historical
init_ref_tools.description: Get metal prices for a specific historical date. Returns spot prices per troy ounce for that day. Useful for tracking price changes or computing returns.

init_ref_tools.name: mediastack_search_news
init_ref_tools.description: Search news articles by keywords. Optionally filter by category (business, technology, science, health, sports, entertainment, general), country (ISO2 codes), or language. Returns headlines, descriptions, sources, and published dates.

keywords.description: Search keywords (e.g., "artificial intelligence", "climate summit")

categories.description: Comma-separated categories: business, technology, science, health, sports, entertainment, general

init_ref_tools.name: latest_news
init_ref_tools.description: Get the latest news headlines. Optionally filter by category, country, or language. Returns the most recent articles with titles, descriptions, sources, and URLs.

categories.description: Comma-separated categories: business, technology, science, health, sports, entertainment, general

init_ref_tools.name: get_rent_estimate
init_ref_tools.description: Get a rental price estimate for a US property address. Returns estimated monthly rent, price range, and comparable rental data. Example: "1234 Main St, Austin, TX 78701".

address.description: Full street address with city, state, and ZIP (e.g., "5500 Grand Lake Dr, San Antonio, TX 78244")

init_ref_tools.name: get_property
init_ref_tools.description: Get property details for a US address. Returns bedrooms, bathrooms, square footage, lot size, year built, property type, and owner info when available.

address.description: Full street address with city, state, and ZIP (e.g., "123 Oak Ave, Denver, CO 80202")

init_ref_tools.name: healthdata_search_datasets
init_ref_tools.description: Search HealthData.gov for public health datasets by keyword (e.g., "COVID hospitalizations", "Medicare spending", "opioid prescriptions"). Returns dataset titles, descriptions, organizations, and resource links.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "vaccination rates", "hospital readmissions", "air quality health")

init_ref_tools.name: healthdata_get_dataset
init_ref_tools.description: Get full metadata for a HealthData.gov dataset by its package ID. Returns title, description, organization, resources (CSV/JSON download links), update frequency, and tags.

init_ref_tools.name: wikidata_search_entities
init_ref_tools.description: Search Wikidata entities by label or alias (e.g., "Albert Einstein", "Python programming language", "Tokyo"). Returns entity IDs, labels, descriptions, and aliases. Useful for finding the Wikidata ID of any concept.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "Marie Curie", "Bitcoin", "Great Wall of China")

init_ref_tools.name: wikidata_get_entity
init_ref_tools.description: Get full Wikidata entity by ID (e.g., "Q42" for Douglas Adams, "Q5" for human, "Q1764" for Budapest). Returns labels, descriptions, aliases, claims/statements (properties and values), and sitelinks.

init_ref_tools.name: arxiv_search_papers
init_ref_tools.description: Search arXiv preprints. Plain text searches all fields; use prefixes for targeted queries: au:hinton (author), ti:transformer (title), abs:diffusion (abstract), cat:cs.AI (category), all:quantum (any field). Combine with AND/OR/ANDNOT, e.g., "ti:transformer AND cat:cs.LG". Returns id, title, authors, abstract, categories, published date, PDF URL.

query.description: Query string. Plain text or field-prefixed (au:, ti:, abs:, cat:, all:). Combine terms with AND, OR, ANDNOT.

sort_by.description: relevance | lastUpdatedDate | submittedDate (default relevance)

init_ref_tools.name: arxiv_get_paper
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single arXiv paper by its ID (e.g., "2310.06825", "2310.06825v2", or legacy "cs.CL/0301001"). Returns full metadata: title, authors, abstract, categories, DOI (if linked), PDF URL.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv identifier (with or without version suffix)

init_ref_tools.name: search_observations
init_ref_tools.description: Search citizen-science observations on iNaturalist. Filter by taxon name (e.g., "Pandion haliaetus" or "osprey"), place name ("California"), year, threatened status, or quality grade. Returns photographed sightings with coordinates, dates, and observer info. Pairs well with GBIF for cross-validation.

place.description: Place name (country, state, park). Auto-resolved to place_id.

init_ref_tools.name: search_taxa
init_ref_tools.description: Search iNaturalist taxa by name (common or scientific). Returns taxon ID, rank, ancestry, conservation status, and photo URL. Use the taxon ID for downstream filters or to disambiguate look-alike species.

rank.description: Restrict to a rank (kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species)

query.description: Common or scientific name

init_ref_tools.name: top_species
init_ref_tools.description: Most-frequently-observed species in a place over a date range. Auto-resolves place name to place_id. Returns ranked species with observation counts and taxonomic info. Great for "what wildlife lives here?" questions.

init_ref_tools.name: list_popular_indicators
init_ref_tools.description: List curated Our World in Data indicators (slug + title) for common categories: energy, climate, health, demographics, economy, food, education, environment, tech, politics. Use the slug with fetch_indicator. Not exhaustive — visit ourworldindata.org for the full catalog.

init_ref_tools.name: fetch_indicator
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch tidy long-format data for an OWID indicator by slug (e.g., "co-emissions-per-capita", "life-expectancy"). Returns rows of {entity, year, value}. Optional country filter accepts ISO codes or names ("USA", "World", "China"). Browse slugs at ourworldindata.org/charts.

slug.description: OWID chart slug (the URL path segment)

country.description: Filter to a single entity (country/region name or ISO code)

init_ref_tools.name: get_indicator_metadata
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch metadata for an OWID indicator: title, subtitle, units, source(s), last updated. Helpful before fetching to verify the slug.

init_ref_tools.name: oecd_list_curated_flows
init_ref_tools.description: List OECD dataflow refs we have pre-vetted, grouped by topic (gdp, labour, prices, finance, households, health, demographics, projections, tax, education, environment, technology). Pass the flow_ref to fetch_dataset. For everything else use search_dataflows or browse https://data-explorer.oecd.org.

topic.description: Optional topic filter

init_ref_tools.name: oecd_search_dataflows
init_ref_tools.description: Search OECD's SDMX dataflow registry by keyword. Returns matching dataflow refs ready to pass to fetch_dataset. If results are noisy, refine with a more specific keyword or restrict by agency.

query.description: Keyword (matches dataflow names + descriptions)

agency.description: Optional agency filter, e.g., OECD.SDD.NAD, OECD.ECO, OECD.ENV

init_ref_tools.name: oecd_fetch_dataset
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch tidy rows from any OECD dataflow. flow_ref examples: "OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAMAIN1@DF_QNA_EXPENDITURE_GROWTH,1.0". The key string is a dot-separated dimension filter (e.g., "USA.....Q" — leave empty to fetch everything). Use start/end periods like "2020-Q1" or "2020". Returns labeled rows; OECD enforces a result-size limit and may truncate broad queries — narrow with key dimensions or shorter time ranges.

key.description: Dot-separated dimension key (or empty for all)

init_ref_tools.name: search_lei
init_ref_tools.description: Search the GLEIF LEI registry by legal entity name. Returns matched entities with their 20-character LEI, jurisdiction, status, and BIC/ISIN cross-references. Use the LEI to resolve canonical identity across SEC, OpenSanctions, and counterparty databases.

query.description: Legal entity name (full or partial)

country.description: Restrict to a jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., "US", "DE")

init_ref_tools.name: get_lei
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch the full Level 1 LEI record by 20-character LEI code. Returns legal name, registered address, headquarters address, entity category, legal form, registration authority, status, parent LEI (if any), and timestamps.

init_ref_tools.name: get_lei_relationships
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch Level 2 corporate hierarchy for an LEI: direct parent, ultimate parent, and direct children. Use to map ownership trees across multinational groups.

init_ref_tools.name: search_grants
init_ref_tools.description: Search NIH-funded research projects. Filter by free-text query (matches title/abstract/terms), PI name, organization, fiscal year, US state, or NIH institute code (NCI, NHLBI, NIAID, etc.). Returns project number, PI, institution, fiscal year, award amount, and abstract preview.

query.description: Free-text search across title, abstract, terms

pi_name.description: PI last name (or any name part)

init_ref_tools.name: nih_reporter_get_project
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single NIH grant record by application ID (numeric, distinct from project number). Returns full project details including complete abstract, PIs, terms, sub-projects, and award history.

init_ref_tools.name: nih_reporter_search_publications
init_ref_tools.description: Search publications acknowledging NIH funding. Filter by PMID, application ID, or core project number. Useful for "what came out of this grant" follow-ups.

init_ref_tools.name: search_awards
init_ref_tools.description: Search NSF awards. Filter by keyword (matches title/abstract), PI name, awardee institution, NSF program, date range, US state, or country. Returns title, PI, awardee, amount, dates, program. Use get_award for full abstract + outcomes report.

limit.description: Results per page (1-25, default 25 — NSF max)

country.description: Awardee country code (e.g., "US")

program.description: NSF program name (e.g., "Algorithms in the Field")

init_ref_tools.name: get_award
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single NSF award by ID. Returns full abstract, project outcomes report (if completed), and detailed PI/awardee info.

init_ref_tools.name: search_opportunities
init_ref_tools.description: Search Grants.gov for currently-open or recently-closed federal funding opportunities. Filter by keyword, opportunity status, agency code, funding category, or date range. Returns opportunity number, title, agency, open/close dates, and assistance listing numbers (formerly CFDA).

status.description: forecasted | posted | closed | archived (default posted; use a pipe to combine, e.g. "posted|forecasted")

funding_categories.description: Comma-separated category codes (e.g., "ED" education, "ENV" environment, "ST" science)

init_ref_tools.name: get_opportunity
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch full details for a Grants.gov opportunity by ID. Returns synopsis text, eligibility, award ceiling/floor, attachments, contact info, and version history.

opportunity_id.description: Numeric opportunity ID (returned by search_opportunities as "id")

init_ref_tools.name: gdelt_search_articles
init_ref_tools.description: Search global news articles indexed by GDELT 2.0. Returns recent matches with URL, title, domain, source country, language, tone (-100..+100), and image. Use the query language: plain words AND together, "quotes" for phrases, parens for OR groups, "-word" to exclude, "sourcecountry:US" / "sourcelang:eng" / "theme:TERROR" / "near:Paris~50" for advanced filters.

query.description: GDELT query string

timespan.description: Lookback window: e.g., "24h", "7d", "1m", "custom" (paired with startdatetime/enddatetime). Default 7d.

init_ref_tools.name: timeline_tone
init_ref_tools.description: Day-by-day average tone (-100 very negative .. +100 very positive) for a GDELT query over time. Returns datapoints with timestamp and tone value. Useful for tracking sentiment shifts around a topic, person, or place.

query.description: GDELT query string

init_ref_tools.name: timeline_volume
init_ref_tools.description: Day-by-day article volume as % of total news for a GDELT query. Returns datapoints with timestamp and intensity. Useful for spotting topic spikes and comparing news attention across periods.

query.description: GDELT query string

init_ref_tools.name: search_events
init_ref_tools.description: Search ACLED political-violence and protest events. Filter by country (use "|" to OR, e.g., "Ukraine|Russia"), region, event_type, actor, ISO country code, or date range. Returns date, lat/lon, actors, event type, fatalities, and source notes.

iso.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric country code (alternative to country)

actor.description: Match actor1 or actor2 (partial substring ok)

limit.description: Records to return (1-5000, default 100; ACLED max-per-call is 5000)

country.description: Country name(s), pipe-separated for OR

event_type.description: Battles | Protests | Riots | Explosions/Remote violence | Violence against civilians | Strategic developments

init_ref_tools.name: event_counts_by_country
init_ref_tools.description: Aggregate event and fatality counts by country over a date range. Useful for cross-country comparison and time-bounded risk snapshots.

init_ref_tools.name: companies_house_search_companies
init_ref_tools.description: Search UK Companies House by company name. Returns matches with company number, name, status (active/dissolved), type, registered office address, and incorporation date. Use the company_number to look up officers, filings, and PSCs.

query.description: Company name (full or partial)

init_ref_tools.name: companies_house_get_company
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single UK company profile by company number. Returns registered name, status, type, SIC codes, registered office, accounts/confirmation-statement due dates, and links to officers/filings/charges/PSCs.

init_ref_tools.name: get_officers
init_ref_tools.description: List directors and secretaries for a UK company. Returns name, role, appointment/resignation dates, occupation, country of residence, nationality, and date of birth (month/year only).

init_ref_tools.name: get_filings
init_ref_tools.description: Filing history for a UK company — annual returns, accounts, changes of address/directors, charges, mortgages. Returns category, description, filing date, transaction ID, and links to filed documents.

init_ref_tools.name: get_persons_with_significant_control
init_ref_tools.description: Beneficial-ownership records (PSCs) for a UK company — individuals or entities with significant control. Returns name, kind, nature of control, ownership-of-shares brackets, and country of residence.

init_ref_tools.name: permid_search_entities
init_ref_tools.description: Search PermID for organizations, people, instruments, or quotes by name. Returns PermID, primary type, name, and a brief context. Use get_entity with the PermID for the full linked-data record.

query.description: Free-text search term

init_ref_tools.name: permid_get_entity
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch the full PermID record by ID. For organizations: legal name, headquarters, identifiers (RIC, ISIN, ticker, LEI), industry codes, public/private status. For people: name, type, affiliations.

init_ref_tools.name: lookup_file
init_ref_tools.description: Look up a file by hash (sha256, sha1, or md5). Returns last-analysis stats (malicious / suspicious / harmless / undetected detector counts), type description, size, names seen, and tags. Useful for triaging hashes seen in alerts or logs.

hash.description: SHA-256 / SHA-1 / MD5 of the file

init_ref_tools.name: virustotal_lookup_url
init_ref_tools.description: Look up a URL's reputation. Returns last-analysis stats across all engines, categories (per vendor), and whether the URL has been redirected. The URL is canonicalized before lookup; no submission step is required to read existing reports.

url.description: Full URL including scheme

init_ref_tools.name: lookup_domain
init_ref_tools.description: Look up a domain. Returns last-analysis stats, categories per vendor, last DNS records, popularity ranks, and reputation score.

init_ref_tools.name: virustotal_lookup_ip
init_ref_tools.description: Look up an IPv4 address. Returns last-analysis stats, ASN/owner, country, network range, and reputation score.

init_ref_tools.name: ip_context
init_ref_tools.description: Look up an IPv4 against the GreyNoise Community dataset. Returns noise (is the IP scanning the internet?), riot (is it a known good service like Google/Microsoft?), classification (malicious | benign | unknown), name, last-seen date, and a deep link. Useful for noise-suppression in SOC alerts.

init_ref_tools.name: check_password
init_ref_tools.description: Check whether a password appears in known breach corpora. Uses k-anonymity: the password is SHA-1ed locally, only the first 5 hex chars leave the worker, and the response is filtered to match the rest. Returns pwned count (0 = not seen). The password itself is never transmitted.

password.description: Password to check (stays inside the worker)

init_ref_tools.name: check_password_prefix
init_ref_tools.description: Direct k-anonymity lookup: pass the first 5 hex chars of a SHA-1 password hash, get back all SHA-1 suffixes with their pwned counts. Use this if you're hashing client-side and only want to send the prefix.

init_ref_tools.name: list_breaches
init_ref_tools.description: List all publicly-known data breaches catalogued by HIBP. Optionally filter to a specific domain (e.g., "linkedin.com"). Returns name, title, breach date, added date, affected accounts, description, data classes exposed, and verification status.

domain.description: Restrict to a specific breached domain

init_ref_tools.name: get_breach
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single breach by name (the "Name" field from list_breaches, e.g., "Adobe", "LinkedIn"). Returns full breach metadata.

init_ref_tools.name: list_data_classes
init_ref_tools.description: Canonical list of HIBP "data class" tags (e.g., "Email addresses", "Passwords", "Geographic locations"). Useful for filtering breaches.

init_ref_tools.name: check_account
init_ref_tools.description: Look up breaches an email account has been seen in. REQUIRES a paid HIBP subscription key (pass _apiKey). Returns the set of breach names; combine with get_breach for details.

truncate.description: Return only breach names (default true). Set false for full breach objects (counts as 1 query).

init_ref_tools.name: search_pulses
init_ref_tools.description: Search OTX threat-intel pulses by keyword. Returns pulse ID, name, description preview, tags, targeted countries, malware families, attack IDs, and indicator count.

query.description: Search term

init_ref_tools.name: get_pulse
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single OTX pulse: full description, references, indicators, attack IDs, targeted countries, malware families, industries, and creation/modification dates.

init_ref_tools.name: lookup_indicator
init_ref_tools.description: Look up an indicator (IPv4, domain, URL, or file hash) in OTX. Returns pulses referencing the indicator and observed-context fields. type auto-detected when omitted.

type.description: Force a type instead of auto-detecting

indicator.description: IPv4, domain, URL, or file hash (md5/sha1/sha256)

init_ref_tools.name: etherscan_get_balance
init_ref_tools.description: Native-token balance for an address on a supported EVM chain. Defaults to Ethereum mainnet. Accepts chain by slug (ethereum, polygon, bsc, base, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, fantom, gnosis, linea, scroll, zksync, blast, mantle) or numeric chain ID.

chain.description: Chain slug or numeric chain ID (default ethereum)

init_ref_tools.name: get_token_balance
init_ref_tools.description: ERC-20 token balance for an address against a specific token contract.

chain.description: Chain slug or numeric chain ID (default ethereum)

init_ref_tools.name: list_transactions
init_ref_tools.description: List transactions for an address. type controls which list: "normal" (regular EOA txs), "internal" (contract-internal value transfers), "erc20" (ERC-20 transfers), "erc721" (NFT transfers), "erc1155" (multi-token transfers).

type.description: normal | internal | erc20 | erc721 | erc1155 (default normal)

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

init_ref_tools.name: get_contract_abi
init_ref_tools.description: Verified contract ABI as JSON (if the contract is verified on Etherscan).

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

init_ref_tools.name: get_contract_source
init_ref_tools.description: Verified contract source code, compiler version, optimization settings, and license.

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

init_ref_tools.name: web_search
init_ref_tools.description: General web search via the Brave index. Returns title, URL, description snippet, age, language, and site categories. Optional country, language, safesearch, and freshness filters.

country.description: 2-letter country code (e.g., "us", "gb")

freshness.description: pd (past day) | pw (past week) | pm (past month) | py (past year) | YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD

init_ref_tools.name: news_search
init_ref_tools.description: News-specific search with publication metadata. Returns title, URL, source, age, snippet, and breaking-news flag.

country.description: 2-letter country code

init_ref_tools.name: short_answer
init_ref_tools.description: Get a single terse plain-text answer from Wolfram Alpha. Best for: arithmetic, unit conversion, "what is X", "how many Y in Z", factual lookups (planet diameter, country GDP, element atomic weight, current time in Tokyo). Returns one string.

query.description: Natural-language query

init_ref_tools.name: full_query
init_ref_tools.description: Get the full structured result from Wolfram Alpha. Returns named "pods" (Input, Result, Solution, Plot, Properties, etc.) — useful when short_answer is too terse or you need multiple facets (e.g., element properties, equation solution + plot + alternate forms).

query.description: Natural-language query

format.description: plaintext (default) | plaintext,image — plaintext is most agent-friendly.

include_pods.description: Comma-separated pod IDs to restrict (e.g., "Result,Solution"). Default: return all.

init_ref_tools.name: get_oa
init_ref_tools.description: Given a DOI, fetch open-access status and the best free legal copy if one exists. Returns is_oa, oa_status (gold | green | hybrid | bronze | closed), best location (URL, host type, license), and journal metadata.

init_ref_tools.name: unpaywall_search_papers
init_ref_tools.description: Keyword search across Unpaywall's coverage of scholarly papers. Optionally restrict to OA-only. Returns up to 50 results per page.

query.description: Search term

init_ref_tools.name: overpass_query
init_ref_tools.description: Run a raw Overpass QL query against OpenStreetMap. Use for complex spatial queries the helper tools can't express. Example: `[out:json][timeout:25]; area["name"="Berlin"][admin_level=4]->.a; node["amenity"="library"](area.a); out body;`. Returns the raw Overpass JSON (elements array with node/way/relation).

qql.description: Full Overpass QL query string. Start with `[out:json][timeout:<n>];` and end with `out body;` (or similar output statement).

init_ref_tools.name: pois_near
init_ref_tools.description: Find OSM points of interest within a radius of a lat/lon. Pass an OSM key=value tag like "amenity=cafe", "shop=bakery", "tourism=museum", or just "amenity" to match any value. Returns nodes with names, tags, and coordinates.

init_ref_tools.name: places_in_bbox
init_ref_tools.description: Find OSM POIs inside a bounding box. Use for "every park in this area" or "all restaurants in this neighborhood". Bounding box is (south, west, north, east) in degrees.

init_ref_tools.name: open_library_search_books
init_ref_tools.description: Search Open Library by title, author, or subject. Use prefixed terms: `title:gatsby author:fitzgerald` or plain text for broad search. Returns work key, title, author, first publish year, edition count, ISBNs, and cover ID.

query.description: Search string (prefixed or plain)

init_ref_tools.name: get_book_by_isbn
init_ref_tools.description: Look up a single book by ISBN (10 or 13). Returns title, authors, publishers, publish date, page count, subjects, identifiers, and cover URL.

init_ref_tools.name: open_library_get_work
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch the canonical "work" record (concept of a book across editions). Returns title, description, subjects, first publish date, links to editions and the author.

work_id.description: Open Library work ID (e.g., "OL45804W" — the W-suffixed identifier)

init_ref_tools.name: open_library_get_author
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch an author record. Returns bio, birth/death dates, alternate names, and links to works.

author_id.description: Open Library author ID (e.g., "OL34184A" — the A-suffixed identifier)

init_ref_tools.name: search_shows
init_ref_tools.description: Search TV shows by name. Returns shows with id, name, premiere date, network, genres, rating, status, and TVMaze URL.

query.description: Show name (full or partial)

init_ref_tools.name: tvmaze_get_show
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a full show record by TVMaze ID. Optionally embed episodes, cast, seasons, or previous/next episode info for richer responses.

init_ref_tools.name: list_episodes
init_ref_tools.description: List all episodes of a show. Returns season, number, name, airdate, runtime, and summary.

init_ref_tools.name: tvmaze_get_schedule
init_ref_tools.description: What TV shows are airing on a given day in a country. Useful for "what aired last night on UK TV". Returns episode + show records.

country.description: 2-letter country code (default "US")

init_ref_tools.name: tvmaze_search_people
init_ref_tools.description: Search actors / people by name. Returns id, name, country, birthday, gender, image.

query.description: Person name

init_ref_tools.name: nws_get_forecast
init_ref_tools.description: Get the 7-day NWS forecast for a US lat/lon. Returns named periods (e.g., "Tonight", "Wednesday") with high/low temperature, wind, and a short text forecast. US locations only.

init_ref_tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
init_ref_tools.description: Get the hourly NWS forecast for a US lat/lon (~168 hours). Useful for short-term planning, severe-weather windows, or precipitation timing.

init_ref_tools.name: nws_get_alerts
init_ref_tools.description: Active NWS watches / warnings / advisories. Filter by US state (2-letter code), point (lat,lon), severity, or status. Returns event name, severity, urgency, headline, description, affected areas, and effective/expires times.

event.description: Restrict to a specific event type (e.g., "Tornado Warning")

latitude.description: Latitude (use with longitude for point query)

longitude.description: Longitude (use with latitude for point query)

init_ref_tools.name: get_observation
init_ref_tools.description: Latest observation from a specific NWS weather station. Returns temperature, humidity, wind, visibility, pressure, and present-weather codes.

init_ref_tools.name: get_daily_history
init_ref_tools.description: Daily historical weather for a Meteostat station between two dates. Returns date-keyed temperature (avg/min/max), precipitation, snow, wind, pressure, sun hours. Station IDs are numeric — find them at meteostat.net (URL suffix).

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive

init_ref_tools.name: get_monthly_normals
init_ref_tools.description: Monthly climate normals for a station — long-run averages of temperature, precipitation, and pressure by calendar month. Useful for "what's normal in May here" baselines.

init_ref_tools.name: search_dois
init_ref_tools.description: Search DataCite-registered DOIs. Filter by free-text query, resource type (dataset, software, etc.), year, publisher, or affiliation. Returns DOI, title, creators, publisher, type, year, citation count.

query.description: Free-text query (titles, descriptions, creators)

resource_type.description: Dataset | Software | Text | Image | Sound | Other (case-sensitive)

init_ref_tools.name: get_doi
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single DOI record. Returns full metadata: title(s), creators with affiliations and ORCIDs, abstract, publisher, year, dates, related identifiers, subjects, license, sizes/formats.

init_ref_tools.name: list_repositories
init_ref_tools.description: List DataCite-registered data repositories (e.g., Zenodo, Dryad, Figshare). Filter by query. Useful for "where do I deposit a dataset" lookups.

query.description: Repository name / description filter

init_ref_tools.name: search_by_name
init_ref_tools.description: Resolve a common chemical or drug name to PubChem CIDs. Use for "what's the CID of ibuprofen?" or to disambiguate. Returns CIDs (Compound IDs) matched to the name. Then use get_compound with the CID for properties.

init_ref_tools.name: get_compound
init_ref_tools.description: Get standard properties for a PubChem CID: molecular formula, molecular weight, IUPAC name, canonical SMILES, isomeric SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, exact mass, charge, complexity, H-bond donors/acceptors, rotatable bonds, TPSA, XLogP, heavy atom count.

init_ref_tools.name: pubchem_get_synonyms
init_ref_tools.description: List all names (synonyms) for a CID — common names, IUPAC, trade names, CAS numbers, etc.

init_ref_tools.name: get_classification
init_ref_tools.description: Pharmacological classification tree for a CID — drug class, mechanism of action, biological role tags. Useful for "what kind of drug is X" questions.

init_ref_tools.name: list_volcanoes
init_ref_tools.description: List every US volcano monitored by USGS with current alert level (Normal/Advisory/Watch/Warning) and aviation color code (Green/Yellow/Orange/Red). Filter optionally by observatory.

observatory.description: Observatory short code (AVO=Alaska, CVO=Cascades, YVO=Yellowstone, HVO=Hawaiian, CalVO=California). Optional.

init_ref_tools.name: list_elevated
init_ref_tools.description: List only the volcanoes currently above Normal/Green status (i.e., elevated unrest or eruption). Smallest practical fingerprint of "what's happening right now."

init_ref_tools.name: list_notices
init_ref_tools.description: Recent USGS volcano notices and reports — observatory updates, VAN (Volcano Activity Notice) and VONA (Volcano Observatory Notice for Aviation) text. Filter by volcano slug.

volcano_slug.description: USGS volcano slug (e.g., "kilauea", "shishaldin"). Optional — omit for all recent.

init_ref_tools.name: foursquare_search_places
init_ref_tools.description: Search Foursquare places. Combine `query` (e.g., "coffee", "hardware store") with a location anchor — either `near` ("Brooklyn, NY") or `latitude`+`longitude`. Returns name, fsq_place_id, categories, address, distance, lat/lon, popularity.

query.description: Free-text query

categories.description: Comma-separated Foursquare category IDs (fsq_category_id)

init_ref_tools.name: get_place
init_ref_tools.description: Full place details by fsq_place_id. Returns name, categories, address, lat/lon, social media, website, hours, rating, price, popularity.

init_ref_tools.name: nearby_places
init_ref_tools.description: POIs near a lat/lon without a search term. Uses the new search endpoint with location bias and no query.

categories.description: Comma-separated category IDs

init_ref_tools.name: list_parks
init_ref_tools.description: List or search NPS parks. Filter by free-text query, state code (2-letter, comma-separated), or parkCode list. Returns full name, description, designation, states, GPS, address, official URL.

query.description: Free-text search

init_ref_tools.name: get_park
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single park by parkCode. Returns full description, designation, activities, topics, address, contacts, operating hours, entrance fees, and image gallery.

init_ref_tools.name: list_alerts
init_ref_tools.description: Current park alerts — closures, road conditions, weather warnings, danger advisories. Filter by parkCode or state.

query.description: Free-text alert search

init_ref_tools.name: list_campgrounds
init_ref_tools.description: Campgrounds inside a park or state. Returns name, description, RV/tent capacity, amenities, reservation info, GPS.

query.description: Free-text query (optional)

init_ref_tools.name: list_things_to_do
init_ref_tools.description: Activities recommended by the park service — hikes, ranger programs, scenic drives, ranger-led activities. Filter by parkCode or state.

query.description: Free-text query (optional)

init_ref_tools.name: get_aqi_by_city
init_ref_tools.description: Real-time AQI for a city. Returns AQI value, dominant pollutant, individual pollutant readings (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO), temperature/humidity/pressure, and station info.

init_ref_tools.name: get_aqi_by_location
init_ref_tools.description: Real-time AQI for the WAQI station nearest a lat/lon.

init_ref_tools.name: get_aqi_by_station
init_ref_tools.description: Real-time AQI for a specific WAQI station by UID (numeric).

init_ref_tools.name: waqi_search_stations
init_ref_tools.description: Search stations by keyword (city/region name). Returns station UID, name, current AQI, and location.

init_ref_tools.name: libretranslate_translate
init_ref_tools.description: Translate text. Source can be "auto" to auto-detect. Returns translated text and the detected source (if applicable).

text.description: Text to translate

target.description: Target language code (e.g., "es", "fr", "ja")

init_ref_tools.name: libretranslate_detect_language
init_ref_tools.description: Detect the source language of a piece of text. Returns ranked language candidates with confidence.

text.description: Text to analyze

init_ref_tools.name: libretranslate_list_languages
init_ref_tools.description: List languages supported by the configured LibreTranslate instance.

init_ref_tools.name: search_factors
init_ref_tools.description: Search Climatiq's emission-factor database. Use to discover factor IDs and required parameters before calling estimate_emissions. Filter by query, category, source (e.g., "EPA", "DEFRA"), region (ISO code), or year.

query.description: Free-text search (e.g., "electricity grid", "concrete production")

unit_type.description: Activity unit type (Energy, Volume, Distance, Mass, etc.)

init_ref_tools.name: estimate_emissions
init_ref_tools.description: Calculate kgCO₂e for an activity. Pass an emission_factor with at minimum `activity_id` (from search_factors) or `id`, plus the required `parameters` (e.g., `{ energy: 200, energy_unit: "kWh" }`). Returns CO₂e + breakdown.

parameters.description: Activity quantities matching the factor's required unit type (e.g., {energy:200, energy_unit:"kWh"}).

emission_factor.description: Selector object — at minimum {activity_id: "..."} or {id: "..."}. May add region, year, source for disambiguation.

init_ref_tools.name: list_unit_types
init_ref_tools.description: List supported unit-type families (Energy / Volume / Distance / Mass / etc.) and their valid units.

init_ref_tools.name: query_subgraph
init_ref_tools.description: Run a GraphQL query against a subgraph on The Graph network. subgraph_id is the deployment hash (starts with "Qm…" or the new "0x…" subgraph ID from thegraph.com/explorer). Returns the GraphQL `data` block plus any errors.

query.description: GraphQL query string

variables.description: Optional GraphQL variables object

subgraph_id.description: Subgraph deployment ID (look up at thegraph.com/explorer; e.g., Uniswap v3 Ethereum is "5zvR82QoaXYFyDEKLZ9t6v9adgnptxYpKpSbxtgVENFV")

init_ref_tools.name: introspect_schema
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a subgraph's GraphQL schema via standard introspection. Returns types, fields, and arguments so an agent can build queries without external docs.

init_ref_tools.name: get_account_detail
init_ref_tools.description: Overview of a Solana account: SOL balance (lamports + UI), owner program, executable flag, rent epoch.

init_ref_tools.name: get_token_holdings
init_ref_tools.description: SPL-token balances held by a Solana account. Returns mint, symbol, amount, decimals, USD value (if known).

init_ref_tools.name: list_transfers
init_ref_tools.description: Recent SOL and SPL token transfers for an account. Returns signature, timestamp, side (sent/received), token, amount, counterparty.

init_ref_tools.name: get_token_meta
init_ref_tools.description: Metadata for an SPL token mint: name, symbol, decimals, supply, icon, market cap, holders, social links.

init_ref_tools.name: solscan_get_transaction
init_ref_tools.description: Transaction detail by signature: status, slot, block time, fee, balance changes, parsed instructions.

init_ref_tools.name: list_competitions
init_ref_tools.description: List competitions accessible on your plan. Free tier: 12 majors. Use the returned `code` (e.g., "PL", "PD", "CL") for downstream calls.

init_ref_tools.name: get_competition_matches

init_ref_tools.name: football_data_get_team

init_ref_tools.name: internet_quality

init_ref_tools.name: bgp_leaks

init_ref_tools.name: get_nft

init_ref_tools.name: list_owned_nfts

init_ref_tools.name: search_titles

init_ref_tools.name: get_by_title

type.description: movie | series | episode

init_ref_tools.name: get_by_imdb_id

init_ref_tools.name: current_by_zip

init_ref_tools.name: current_by_location
init_ref_tools.description: Latest observed AQI for the AirNow station nearest a lat/lon.

init_ref_tools.name: forecast_by_zip
init_ref_tools.description: AQI forecast for a US ZIP code on a given date (defaults to today). Useful for "is tomorrow ok for outdoor activity" decisions.

init_ref_tools.name: observations_in_bbox
init_ref_tools.description: Historical AQI observations inside a bounding box for a date range. Specify pollutants as comma-separated parameter codes (e.g., "OZONE,PM25,PM10,CO,NO2,SO2"). bbox format: "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat".

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DDT00 (hour-granular ISO truncated)

init_ref_tools.name: openstates_search_bills
init_ref_tools.description: Search bills in any US statehouse. Pass jurisdiction as a 2-letter state code (e.g., "CA", "NY", "TX") or full name. Returns bill identifiers, titles, classifications, last action, sponsors, and OpenStates IDs for use with get_bill.

query.description: Free-text search across title/summary

jurisdiction.description: 2-letter state code or jurisdiction name

init_ref_tools.name: openstates_get_bill
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single bill with full detail: versions, sponsorships, related/companion bills, actions, and votes. Pass the OpenStates ID (e.g., "ocd-bill/abc...") or a state/session/identifier triple.

init_ref_tools.name: search_legislators

init_ref_tools.name: get_legislator

init_ref_tools.name: govtrack_search_bills

init_ref_tools.name: govtrack_get_bill
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single bill by GovTrack numeric ID. Returns full status history, cosponsors, related bills, action timeline.

init_ref_tools.name: govtrack_search_members
init_ref_tools.description: Search current and historical congressional members. Filter by role_type (senator | representative), state, party, current (true/false).

congress.description: Restrict to members serving in a specific congress

init_ref_tools.name: govtrack_get_member
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a person record by GovTrack person ID. Returns full role history, ideology score, leadership score, twitterid, website.

init_ref_tools.name: search_votes
init_ref_tools.description: Search roll-call votes. Filter by congress, chamber, category (passage | nomination | amendment | etc.), date range. Returns vote ID, motion, result, totals by party.

init_ref_tools.name: get_vote_detail
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch how each member voted on a roll-call vote. Returns per-member vote options (Yea / Nay / Present / Not Voting).

init_ref_tools.name: fbi_crime_list_agencies
init_ref_tools.description: List reporting agencies (police departments / sheriffs) for a state. Returns ORI (Originating Reporting Identifier) — the canonical agency ID required by the other tools.

state_abbr.description: 2-letter state code (e.g., "CA"). Omit to list all.

init_ref_tools.name: get_agency
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single agency record by ORI.

init_ref_tools.name: national_estimate
init_ref_tools.description: National crime rate + count estimates for an offense across a year range. Useful for "how has X crime trended nationally".

init_ref_tools.name: state_summary
init_ref_tools.description: Summarized monthly counts of an offense in a state. Returns time-series and totals.

init_ref_tools.name: agency_summary
init_ref_tools.description: Summarized monthly counts of an offense for one agency (by ORI). Returns time-series of victims/incidents/offenders.

init_ref_tools.name: list_offense_slugs
init_ref_tools.description: List the offense slugs accepted by national_estimate / state_summary / agency_summary. Returns a static list.

init_ref_tools.name: regulations_gov_search_dockets
init_ref_tools.description: Search regulatory dockets. Filter by free-text query, agency (acronym like "EPA", "FDA"), docket type (Rulemaking / Nonrulemaking), or date range. Returns dockets with title, agency, type, status, document counts.

query.description: Full-text search

init_ref_tools.name: get_docket
init_ref_tools.description: Single docket detail by docketId (e.g., "EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317"). Returns full metadata + summary counts.

init_ref_tools.name: list_documents
init_ref_tools.description: Documents within a docket (or matching a query). Returns title, type (Rule / Proposed Rule / Notice / Supporting), comment counts, posted date, document ID.

query.description: Free-text query across documents

document_type.description: Rule | Proposed Rule | Notice | Supporting & Related Material | Other

init_ref_tools.name: search_comments
init_ref_tools.description: Public comments filed on a docket or document. Filter by docketId, documentId (e.g., "EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317-0001"), free-text, or date.

query.description: Free-text query

init_ref_tools.name: get_comment
init_ref_tools.description: Single public comment by comment ID. Returns text, submitter, posting date, attachments.

init_ref_tools.name: govinfo_list_collections
init_ref_tools.description: List GovInfo collections (BILLS, CFR, USCODE, FR, CHRG, CRPT, HMAN, PLAW, SERIALSET, USCOURTS, etc.) with package counts. Use the collection code with search_packages to filter.

init_ref_tools.name: govinfo_search_packages
init_ref_tools.description: Full-text + faceted search across GovInfo. Filter by collection codes (comma-separated), date range, congress, court (for USCOURTS), and free-text query. Returns package IDs and titles.

query.description: Free-text search

init_ref_tools.name: govinfo_get_package
init_ref_tools.description: Metadata for a single package by packageId (e.g., "BILLS-118hr1234ih", "FR-2024-05-12"). Returns title, dates, citations, granule count, download links (PDF/XML/MODS).

init_ref_tools.name: list_granules
init_ref_tools.description: List granules within a package — e.g., sections of a CFR title, individual entries in a Federal Register issue. Returns granule IDs + titles.

init_ref_tools.name: get_granule
init_ref_tools.description: Granule metadata for a sub-unit within a package.

init_ref_tools.name: list_cubes
init_ref_tools.description: List all available cubes (lean: productId + title + cansim + dimension count + release date). Use the productId with the other tools. Response is large (~3,000 cubes) — agents should filter client-side or cache.

init_ref_tools.name: get_cube_metadata
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a cube: dimensions, member trees (e.g., "Goods-producing industries", "Services-producing industries"), frequency, geography, last release. Use to figure out a coordinate string for get_latest_data.
