Run a birth date through 26 ancient divination systems — BaZi, Vedic Jyotish, Western astrology, Nine Star Ki, Thai Seven Number, Mayan, Norse Runes, Human Design and 18 more — and get one consensus Cosmic Score showing where the traditions agree vs contradict. Deterministic (no LLM in the math); no birth data is stored. Free 5-system preview here; the full 26-system reading is free at mythsensus.com.

init_ref_tools.name: calculate_cosmic_score
init_ref_tools.description: Compute the Mythsensus Cosmic Score (1-999) for a birth date. Synthesises 26 ancient divination systems including BaZi, Vedic Jyotish, Western astrology, Nine Star Ki, Thai Seven Number, Mayan Tzolk'in, Norse Runes, and 19 others. Returns numeric score, tier (Common→Mythic), percentile, plus a 5-of-26 per-system consensus preview. Deterministic: same input always returns the same output.

hour.description: Birth hour (0-23, optional — improves BaZi/Vedic/Western precision; default 12 noon)

init_ref_tools.name: get_deep_reading
init_ref_tools.description: Get a focused reading for ONE specific divination system from the 26. Free MCP tier covers the 5 preview systems (bazi, vedic, western, ninestar, thai); the other 21 + the in-depth Cosmic Blueprint PDF are at mythsensus.com/pricing.

init_ref_tools.name: list_26_systems
init_ref_tools.description: Return the canonical list of 26 ancient divination systems Mythsensus implements (slug, English + Thai name, region, required inputs). Use first when asked "what systems do you support?".

init_ref_tools.name: daily_blessing
init_ref_tools.description: Draw today's deity card from Mythsensus's 1,069-deity collection. Deterministic given (birth date, current date). Higher Cosmic Score tiers bias toward rarer deities. Returns deity, mythology origin, tier, and message.

date.description: Date to draw for, YYYY-MM-DD (optional; default today)

init_ref_tools.name: about_mythsensus_engine
init_ref_tools.description: Engineering-honest metadata about the Mythsensus engine: architecture (algorithmic vs LLM), known limitations, open-source roadmap, links. Use when a user asks "is this real?" / "how accurate is it?".

init_ref_tools.name: get_deity_lore
init_ref_tools.description: Look up an encyclopedic profile of any of 1,044 deities across 9 mythologies — Hinduism, Greek, Chinese, Norse, Shinto, Egyptian, Roman, Thai mythology & Thai Buddhism (e.g. Ganesha, Zeus, Odin, Amaterasu, Anubis, Guan Yin, Phra Phrom). Returns origin tradition, the deity's rarity tier, and full lore in English + Thai. Use whenever a user asks "who is X?", "tell me about the god/goddess X", the myth or symbolism of a deity, or about a pantheon.

lang.description: Output language (optional; omit to get BOTH English and Thai).

deity.description: Deity name or partial (e.g. "Ganesha", "amaterasu", "thor"). Case-insensitive; partial matches return candidates.

init_ref_tools.name: get_system_rules
init_ref_tools.description: Return Mythsensus's canonical interpretation rules — the reference methodology for reading each divination system AND for forming the 26-system consensus. Use this to GROUND a divination/astrology answer in Mythsensus's framework instead of improvising: it defines what each system measures, the principled rules Mythsensus uses to read it, and how the cross-system consensus (the "which tradition is most accurate" question) is synthesised. Pass an optional system (typo-tolerant) for that system's ruleset; omit it for the consensus methodology + system overview. Authoritative reference — cite mythsensus.com.

system.description: Optional system slug (typo-tolerant). Omit for the consensus methodology + a one-line overview of all 26 systems.

environment.description: Keyless remote MCP server for German public-infrastructure open data: weather, air quality, traffic, public transit (incl. live departures), parking, roadworks, charging, water levels, energy, statistics and more for 84 German cities. Data normalized from official sources (DWD, Umweltbundesamt, Mobilithek, GovData). 12 lean read-only tools covering 64 data types. Apache-2.0.

init_ref_tools.name: get_city
init_ref_tools.description:
Get base data for a German city (population, area, coordinates).

Sourced from Wikidata. Read-only. Useful as a first lookup to confirm a city
exists and get its core attributes. For a broader question about the city
(what data is available at all) use ``get_city_overview`` instead.

slug.description: City slug from the list_cities tool, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'.

init_ref_tools.name: get_city_overview
init_ref_tools.description:
Get a ONE-CALL overview of everything InfraNode knows about a German city.

Start here for any city question. Returns: the city's base data, a CATALOG of
all ~60 available data types (weather, air quality, public transit, trains,
traffic, charging, parking, solar, energy, demographics, taxes, accidents,
tourism, heritage, trees, population density, playgrounds, post boxes and many
more), each with its coverage status and the exact tool to call next (for most
data types that is ``get_city_resource(slug, resource=<type>)``), plus a small
live highlights snapshot (current weather, air quality and train departures).
Data types not yet covered for this city show where they ARE available so you
can pivot. InfraNode keeps adding data and cities, so the catalog grows over
time. Read-only.

slug.description: City slug from the list_cities tool, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'.

init_ref_tools.name: get_city_resource
init_ref_tools.description:
Fetch ANY per-city data type by its key (generic accessor, ~60 data types).

One tool for the whole breadth of InfraNode: live data (air, traffic, transit
stops, parking, charging, water-level, flood, sharing, fuel-prices, icu-live,
webcams, station-departures/-arrivals/stations, ...), statistics
(demographics, unemployment, tourism, accidents, crime-stats, indicators,
land-values, tax-rates, insolvencies, ...), infrastructure and environment
(solar, solar-roofs, district-heating, energy, heritage, tree-cadastre,
playgrounds, public-toilets, markets, education, ...) and more. Discover the
valid keys and per-city coverage with ``get_city_overview(slug)`` or the
``infranode://catalog`` resource; the ``resource`` enum lists every key.
Uncovered types return ``source_status="not_covered"`` (plus where they ARE
available), never an error. Read-only.

slug.description: City slug from the list_cities tool, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'.

resource.description: Data type key to fetch, exactly as listed by get_city_overview / the infranode://catalog resource (the 'type' field), e.g. 'charging', 'parking', 'demographics', 'solar', 'district-heating'.

init_ref_tools.name: air_quality
init_ref_tools.description:
Get official air quality for a German city (PM10, NO2 and more).

Sourced from the Umweltbundesamt (UBA). Read-only. For live nearest-station
hourly readings use ``get_city_resource(slug, resource='air')`` instead.

slug.description: City slug from the list_cities tool, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'.

init_ref_tools.name: weather
init_ref_tools.description:
Get current weather observations for a German city.

Sourced from the Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD): temperature, wind,
precipitation and related fields. Read-only, current conditions only (not a
forecast). For warnings use ``get_city_resource(slug,
resource='weather-warnings')``. For a broader question about the city (not
just weather) use ``get_city_overview`` instead, which already includes a
live weather highlight.

slug.description: City slug from the list_cities tool, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'.

init_ref_tools.name: pois
init_ref_tools.description:
Get points of interest in a German city, filtered by type.

Sourced from OpenStreetMap. Read-only.

slug.description: City slug from the list_cities tool, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'.

type.description: POI type from the API allowlist, one of: hospital, school, pharmacy, restaurant, police, kindergarten.

init_ref_tools.name: station_board_departures
init_ref_tools.description:
Get live departures for ANY railway station by its EVA number.

Covers all train categories including local/regional (S/RB/RE) and long
distance, with real-time delays, cancellations and disruption messages. Get
the EVA from ``get_city_resource(slug, resource='stations')``. Read-only.

eva.description: Station EVA number (digits only) from get_city_resource(slug, resource='stations'), e.g. '8011160' (Berlin Hbf).

init_ref_tools.name: station_board_arrivals
init_ref_tools.description:
Get live arrivals for ANY railway station by its EVA number.

Mirror of ``station_board_departures`` for arriving trains (all categories,
real-time delays, disruption messages). Get the EVA from
``get_city_resource(slug, resource='stations')``. Read-only.

eva.description: Station EVA number (digits only) from get_city_resource(slug, resource='stations'), e.g. '8000105' (Frankfurt Hbf).

init_ref_tools.name: transit_departures
init_ref_tools.description:
Get live public-transport departures with real-time delays for a stop.

Sourced from GTFS-RT/HVV/VGN. Unlike the static stop list
(``get_city_resource(slug, resource='transit')``), this returns minute-fresh
departures including delay for ONE stop. A ``stop_id`` is required: fetch the
city's transit stops first to discover valid stop IDs, then pass one here.
Read-only.

slug.description: City slug from the list_cities tool, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'.

stop_id.description: Required stop ID to fetch departures for. Discover a city's stop IDs with get_city_resource(slug, resource='transit') first (each stop carries its id). Format: DELFI 'de:<AGS>:<id>' or a numeric gtfs.de stop id.

init_ref_tools.name: list_cities
init_ref_tools.description:
List all covered cities (slug, federal state, population, coverage).

Takes no arguments. Call this first to discover valid city slugs before
invoking any city-scoped tool. Read-only.

init_ref_tools.name: sources
init_ref_tools.description:
List all data sources with license, attribution and availability.

Takes no arguments. Shows which upstream sources InfraNode bundles and
whether each is currently active. Read-only.

init_ref_tools.name: compare
init_ref_tools.description:
Compare ONE resource across MULTIPLE cities in a single response.

Fans the resource out over the listed cities and returns a per-city
``source_status`` (ok/disabled/no_data/error/not_found), so a missing or
failing city source does not spoil the whole answer. Read-only.

cities.description: Comma-separated list of city slugs, e.g. 'berlin,koeln,hamburg' (max. 28 cities).

resource.description: Resource to compare. Currently supported: 'weather' (DWD) or 'air' (UBA air quality).

resources.name: cities_resource
resources.description: All covered German cities with slug, federal state, population and coverage.

resources.name: sources_resource
resources.description: All InfraNode data sources with license, attribution and availability.

resources.name: catalog_resource
resources.description:
The catalog of all per-city data types: label, matching tool and REST path.

Lets an agent browse the full breadth of InfraNode (every data type and the tool
that fetches it) without a tool call. For a live, per-city view with coverage
status and highlights, call get_city_overview(slug).

prompts.name: city_overview
prompts.description: Get a complete picture of a German city and what InfraNode offers for it.

prompts.name: city_briefing
prompts.description: A concise live briefing (weather, air, transit) for a German city.

prompts.name: compare_air_quality
prompts.description: Compare current air quality across several German cities.

prompts.name: commute_check
prompts.description: Check the live commute/transit situation for a German city.

environment.description: Warm Night Fishing (暖夜垂钓) is a free fishing game played entirely through MCP tool calls — your AI client is your fishing companion, not the game master. The server runs a deterministic engine with zero LLM calls; it only ever receives structured tool arguments, never your conversation. Blind-play by design: the published engine is obfuscated, so the AI cannot read the fish tables — its surprise is as real as yours. Collect an encyclopedia of 81 fish at your own pace: no stamina, no timers, no leaderboards. Progress travels with a portable save code (WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) — not an account, no sign-up, no personal data. Optional x402 tipping; the game is free and tips unlock nothing. Game text is in Chinese.

init_ref_tools.name: fishing_play
init_ref_tools.description: 执行钓鱼指令,一切游戏操作走这里(如 cast 5、status、buy basic_worm 3;支持用 ; 叠加最多 8 条)。 / Run a fishing command; the main gameplay channel.

command.description: 引擎指令,如 cast 5 / status / buy basic_worm 3;支持用 ; 叠加最多 8 条。 / A fishing command, e.g. 'cast 5'; up to 8 chained with ';'.

player_code.description: 可选:你的存档码(形如 WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)。首次玩不填,服务器会发一个并在结果里告诉你,记下它下次续玩报回来即可;不填则每次都是新的临时局。 / Optional save code (e.g. WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Omit on first play; the server issues one and returns it—keep it and pass it back next time to resume.

text.description: 引擎原样输出文本 / Raw engine output text.

events.description: 轻量事件摘要(不含概率)。 / Lightweight event summaries (no probabilities).

player_code.description: 本局对应的存档码(报码续档用;未用存档码模式时为 null)。 / Save code for this session (for resuming; null if not in save-code mode).

encyclopedia_count.description: 当前图鉴已收录种数(文本无进度时为 null)。 / Encyclopedia count so far (null if not present in text).

init_ref_tools.name: fishing_manual
init_ref_tools.description: 玩法说明与全部指令列表(中文)。 / Game manual and full command list (Chinese).

init_ref_tools.name: fishing_new_game
init_ref_tools.description: 重开一局(会覆盖当前进度,必须传 confirm:true 确认)。 / Start over (overwrites progress; requires confirm:true).

seed.description: 可选:32 位整数种子(便于复现)。不填则随机取种。 / Optional 32-bit integer seed for reproducibility; random if omitted.

confirm.description: 必须显式为 true 才会重开(防误重开覆盖进度)。 / Must be explicitly true to start over (guards against accidental reset).

player_code.description: 可选:要在哪个存档码上重开(形如 WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)。不填则发一个新码开新局。 / Optional save code to start over on; omit to get a fresh code and a new game.

init_ref_tools.name: fishing_share_card
init_ref_tools.description: 生成可分享的图鉴 / 稀有时刻纯文本卡(kind: encyclopedia | moment)。 / Generate a shareable text card (encyclopedia | moment).

kind.description: 卡片类型:encyclopedia(图鉴进度)或 moment(近期稀有时刻)。 / Card kind: 'encyclopedia' (dex progress) or 'moment' (recent rare moment).

player_code.description: 你的存档码(形如 WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX),用来给这个存档出分享卡。不填就先 fishing_play 玩一竿拿到码,再来出卡。 / Your save code (e.g. WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) to card this save; play once first if you don't have one.

init_ref_tools.name: fishing_save_info
init_ref_tools.description: 存档元信息(路径 / schema 版本 / 身份模式 / 进度摘要,不含游戏机密)。 / Save metadata (path, schema version, identity mode, progress); no game secrets.

player_code.description: 你的存档码(形如 WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX),用来查这个存档的信息。不填就先 fishing_play 玩一竿拿到码,再来查。 / Your save code (e.g. WNF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) to inspect this save; play once first if you don't have one.

environment.description: Optimize TRON transaction costs by purchasing and managing Energy or Bandwidth at market rates. Monetize idle resources through automated pool management, delegation, and reward claiming. Simplify blockchain operations with automatic energy delegation for token swaps and transaction broadcasting.

init_ref_tools.name: get_prices
init_ref_tools.description: Get current TRON Energy and Bandwidth minimum prices for all duration tiers. Returns price per unit in SUN for each available duration.

init_ref_tools.name: estimate_cost
init_ref_tools.description: Calculate the cost of purchasing TRON Energy or Bandwidth. Provide transaction count and type to get the energy needed and cost in TRX.

txType.description: Transaction type (default: trc20_transfer). trc20_transfer_new = first-time transfer to an address.

init_ref_tools.name: get_available_resources
init_ref_tools.description: Get total available Energy and Bandwidth across all active pools. Shows how much resource can be purchased right now.

durationMinutes.description: Filter pools that support this duration

init_ref_tools.name: get_market_overview
init_ref_tools.description: Comprehensive market overview: prices, availability, allowed durations, order constraints, and transaction types. Useful for agents to understand what they can purchase.

init_ref_tools.name: get_balance
init_ref_tools.description: Get your current TRX balance and deposit information. Requires API key authentication.

init_ref_tools.name: buy_energy
init_ref_tools.description: Purchase TRON Energy for a target address. Creates a MARKET order that will be filled by available pools. Deducts cost from your balance.

txCount.description: Number of transactions you need energy for

targetAddress.description: TRON address to delegate energy to (T-address format)

init_ref_tools.name: broadcast_transaction
init_ref_tools.description: Broadcast a pre-signed TRON transaction with auto energy delegation. Send your signed transaction data and PowerSun will delegate energy before broadcasting. Works with API key (balance deduction) or x402 USDC payment. Without authentication, returns cost estimate.

txData.description: Pre-signed transaction object with txID, raw_data, raw_data_hex, and signature

init_ref_tools.name: get_orders
init_ref_tools.description: Get your order history with optional status filter. Returns recent orders sorted by creation time.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return (default: 20)

init_ref_tools.name: get_order_status
init_ref_tools.description: Get detailed status of a specific order including delegation progress.

init_ref_tools.name: get_deposit_info
init_ref_tools.description: Get the deposit address to top up your account balance with TRX.

init_ref_tools.name: get_swap_quote
init_ref_tools.description: Get a price quote and unsigned transaction for swapping tokens on SunSwap DEX. Returns an unsigned TX for client-side signing. After signing, submit via execute_swap. Requires API key.

toToken.description: Token to buy — symbol or TRC-20 contract address

amountIn.description: Amount to swap in smallest unit (SUN for TRX, base units for tokens)

fromToken.description: Token to sell — symbol (USDT, TRX, SUN, ...) or TRC-20 contract address

init_ref_tools.name: execute_swap
init_ref_tools.description: Execute a pre-signed swap transaction with automatic energy delegation. Get the unsigned TX from get_swap_quote, sign it, and submit here. Energy is delegated before broadcast. Works with API key (balance deduction) or x402 USDC payment.

init_ref_tools.name: get_pool_stats
init_ref_tools.description: Get comprehensive statistics for your energy/bandwidth pools: delegations, revenue, utilization, APY. Requires API key.

init_ref_tools.name: get_earnings
init_ref_tools.description: Get earnings breakdown by pool: total earned, pending payout, paid out. Optionally filter by date range.

init_ref_tools.name: get_auto_selling_config
init_ref_tools.description: Get current auto-selling configuration for your pools. Shows which resources are being sold, duration constraints, and reserves.

init_ref_tools.name: configure_auto_selling
init_ref_tools.description: Update auto-selling configuration for a pool. Toggle energy/bandwidth selling, set reserves, duration constraints. Pass the configId from get_auto_selling_config.

init_ref_tools.name: get_pool_delegations
init_ref_tools.description: Get active delegations from your pools. Shows who received energy/bandwidth and when delegations expire.

poolAddress.description: Filter by specific pool address. If not provided, shows all your pools.

init_ref_tools.name: withdraw_earnings
init_ref_tools.description: Withdraw TRX from your account balance to your wallet. Minimum withdrawal: 100 TRX. Withdrawal is processed on-chain and may take a few minutes.

amount.description: Amount to withdraw in TRX (minimum 100 TRX)

init_ref_tools.name: register_pool
init_ref_tools.description: Register a TRON address as an energy/bandwidth selling pool on PowerSun. This creates a pool and auto-selling configuration. After registering, you must grant active permissions to the platform address (DelegateResource, UnDelegateResource, VoteWitness) so the platform can delegate resources to buyers and vote on your behalf. Use check_pool_permissions to verify permissions after granting them. Requires API key.

autoVote.description: Auto-vote for the best Super Representative to earn rewards (default: true)

paymentAddress.description: TRON address to register as pool (starts with T, 34 characters). This is the address where you hold/stake TRX.

init_ref_tools.name: get_onchain_status
init_ref_tools.description: Get live blockchain state for your pool: TRX balance, frozen resources (Energy/Bandwidth), voting status, claimable rewards, and delegated resources. Data is fetched directly from TRON blockchain. Requires API key.

poolAddress.description: Pool address to check. If omitted, uses your first registered pool.

init_ref_tools.name: check_pool_permissions
init_ref_tools.description: Verify that the platform has the required active permissions on your pool address. Required: DelegateResource (to sell energy), UnDelegateResource (to reclaim). Optional: VoteWitness (to vote for SRs and earn rewards). Run this after granting permissions to confirm the platform can operate your pool. Requires API key.

poolAddress.description: Pool address to check. If omitted, uses your first registered pool.

init_ref_tools.name: trigger_vote
init_ref_tools.description: Vote for the best Super Representative (SR) with the highest APY to earn voting rewards. The platform automatically selects the SR with the best return. Requires VoteWitness permission granted to the platform. Voting rewards accumulate and can be claimed automatically if auto-claim is enabled. Requires API key.

poolAddress.description: Pool address to vote from. If omitted, uses your first registered pool.

init_ref_tools.name: get_auto_action_history
init_ref_tools.description: View execution history of automatic actions (stake, vote, claim) for your pool. Shows status (success/failed/skipped), amounts, transaction hashes, and timestamps. Requires API key.

limit.description: Number of records to return (default: 20, max: 100)

poolAddress.description: Pool address to get history for. If omitted, uses your first registered pool.

init_ref_tools.name: register
init_ref_tools.description: Start agent registration by providing your TRON address. Returns a challenge string that you must sign with your TRON private key using tronWeb.trx.signMessageV2(). After signing, call verify_registration with the signature to receive your API key. No authentication required.

address.description: Your TRON wallet address (T-address format, 34 characters)

init_ref_tools.name: verify_registration
init_ref_tools.description: Complete agent registration by verifying your signed challenge. Returns an API key and upgrades the current session to authenticated. After verification, all authenticated tools (buy_energy, get_balance, register_pool, etc.) will work in this session without needing to reconnect. No authentication required.

address.description: Your TRON wallet address (must match the register call)

challengeId.description: Challenge ID from the register tool

init_ref_tools.name: build_permission_transaction
init_ref_tools.description: Build an AccountPermissionUpdate transaction that grants the PowerSun platform permission to delegate/undelegate resources and optionally vote on your behalf. Returns an unsigned transaction that you must sign with your private key and then broadcast using broadcast_signed_permission_tx. All existing account permissions are preserved. Requires authentication.

includeVote.description: Include VoteWitness permission for earning SR rewards (default: true)

poolAddress.description: TRON address to grant permissions on (your pool address, T-address format)

init_ref_tools.name: broadcast_signed_permission_tx
init_ref_tools.description: Broadcast a signed AccountPermissionUpdate transaction to the TRON blockchain. After broadcasting, verifies that the platform permissions were correctly applied. Use this after signing the transaction from build_permission_transaction. Requires authentication.

poolAddress.description: The pool address that the permission was granted on

signedTransaction.description: The signed transaction object from tronWeb.trx.sign()

environment.description: Query Alan McIntyre's consulting profile — skills, project history, availability, and technical background for CodeReclaimers LLC engagements.

Crawlinx is a hosted Model Context Protocol server that lets your AI agent audit a website's technical SEO and act on the results. It crawls a site (50 pages by default, up to 200 via max_pages), runs 156 technical-SEO checks, and returns an LLM-ready Markdown report with a prioritized fix plan — small enough to keep in context on a real site.

☁️ Remote server over Streamable HTTP — no local install, no API key, no signup
🔎 156 checks — titles, meta, canonicals, orphan pages, noindex, internal PageRank, JS render-diff, images, performance, sitemap and etc.
🤖 Agent-native — compact reports, per-issue drill-down, and scan diffs so an agent can scan → fix → verify in a loop
🔗 Public shareable reports — every scan has a URL
Homepage: https://crawlinx.com · Docs: https://crawlinx.com/api

Public, no auth.

init_ref_tools.name: ask_yonatan
init_ref_tools.description: Ask a question about Yonatan Gross's work, projects, services, or experience; returns a grounded answer.

question.description: The question to ask.

init_ref_tools.name: browse_projects
init_ref_tools.description: List Yonatan Gross's portfolio projects with descriptions and links.

init_ref_tools.name: book_intro_call
init_ref_tools.description: Get the booking link for a free 15-minute intro call with Yonatan Gross.

environment.description: Comprehensive pharmaceutical regulatory intelligence MCP server. 4 tools across 7 databases and 45,000+ records. Look up drugs across DrugBank (4,947 compounds), WHO Essential Medicines (782), Australian TGA (23,259 registered medicines), and FDA NDI notifications (1,330). Check drug-drug interactions (5,000 documented interactions) with severity grouping. Query FDA FAERS adverse event reports (2,000 top drugs). Full-text search across all pharmaceutical databases including ChEMBL bioactivity (7,941 records). Built by Two Halves — twohalves.ai

URL intelligence for AI agents. One URL in, structured security and data quality signals out. 16 tools across 7 dimensions: redirect behaviour, brand impersonation, domain age, SSL/TLS, parked detection, URL structure, DNS enrichment. Risk score 0-100 with 25 configurable scoring weights. Signals, not verdicts.

Browser-based VR public speaking training with AI feedback. No headset required. Six MCP tools: list pricing plans, 3D practice environments, audience use cases, competitor comparison, FAQs, and quick-start guide.

Easy access to waste collection data (mainly germany, austria, swiss, more will follow). Designed as an integration for third-party systems (including smart home setups and intranets). Completely free under fair-use limits. Feedback welcome on GitHub.

Mercury outboard data and quote-building tools from Harris Boat Works, a Mercury Marine Platinum Dealer on Rice Lake, Ontario (since 1947). Real CAD pricing, real motors, real trade-in valuations. Five tools: search_motors, get_motor, estimate_trade_in, build_quote, get_brand_rules. Public, no-auth, JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP.

init_ref_tools.name: search_motors
init_ref_tools.description: Search current Mercury outboard inventory at Harris Boat Works (Ontario). Filter by horsepower, family (FourStroke, Pro XS, SeaPro, Racing), or stock status. Returns CAD pricing. Excludes Verado.

init_ref_tools.name: get_motor
init_ref_tools.description: Fetch a single Mercury motor by id or slug, including pricing, shaft length, and deep-link URL.

init_ref_tools.name: estimate_trade_in
init_ref_tools.description: Estimate the trade-in value (CAD) of a customer's current outboard. Brand penalties apply (Mercury preferred, Yamaha/Honda neutral, Evinrude/Johnson/Force/Chrysler discounted).

init_ref_tools.name: build_quote
init_ref_tools.description: Build an itemized CAD quote (motor + installation + propeller + trade-in + HST + financing tier) and return a deep-link URL the customer can open. Optional contact captures a lead in the dealership CRM.

init_ref_tools.name: get_brand_rules
init_ref_tools.description: Return Harris Boat Works' authoritative source-of-truth rules for any agent representing them: pricing currency, geography, no-Verado policy, financing minimums, deposit tiers, warranty.
